text:
devon: heads-up, saw a ~3x 95p latency spike for eu-west serving during a small burst (11:27 UTC). cold-starts stayed hot for 60s+. warmpool only filled partially, scaler then scaled back.
raj: saw scaler log this: `target_reduction=2 reason=scaleback_threshold` right after backfill. suspicious timing.
maria: quick profiling -> kernel matchmaking fell back to conservative fp32 kernels for several replicas after joiner. kernel_score dropped due to missing KV entries.
devon: kv hitrate jumped from 92% -> 22% at spike start, then slowly recovered. KV priming seems delayed on warmfork.
ashley: posting a short perf snippet:
```
[perf] 11:27:03 alloc_kernel: l2_match=0.12 score=0.35 -> select fp32_fallback
[perf] 11:27:04 kv_lookup miss_rate=0.78 prefetch_queue=0/16
[metrics] warmpool.fill=3/8 join_latency=420ms
```
infra-bot: deploy info: commit=fix/batching-heuristic, deploy_ts=2054321960, canary=eu-west-1
raj: hypothesis: when joiner is delayed the kernel allocator times out and picks a safer kernel. combined with an aggressive scaleback cooldown zero -> replicas get torn down before KV/caches prime.
maria: also saw increased joiner jitter in syscall traces. looks like scheduling contention on the host during that minute.
devon: proposal: (1) add a short scaleback_hold after warmpool fill (30s), (2) change kernel_matchmaking to prefer previously-used kernel for first 1s, (3) block aggressive scaleback if kv_hitrate < 0.6.
ashley: agree. I'll draft a config patch and run the synthetic burst test (100 qps ramp) against canary. sample config:
```
"scaleback_hold_s": 30,
"kernel_probe_preference": "sticky-first",
"kv_hitrate_threshold": 0.6
```
oncall: I'll watch the canary and hook up tracing. please post perf flamegraphs to the incident ticket.
raj: if others agree I'll add a short-term emergency rollout: hold scaleback flag enabled via feature flag for eu-west.
devon: +1. also adding a small telemetry probe: emit kernel_score and kv_hitrate at joiner completion for 1h window.
maria: noted — I'll add the probe and increase joiner logging level for the canary.
ashley: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/987 (draft). running local synthetic now, will post results ~11:40 UTC. :thumbsup:
devon: thanks. filing follow-up incident task INC-2025 with timeline + artifacts. will call a quick triage if canary shows improvement.
infra-bot: incident created INC-2025 by devon
devon: ok team, monitoring. keep replies brief here so we can correlate with traces.
